tool_suggestions.title: Workspace Performance Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a dashboard to analyze and display key performance metrics of each workspace, helping teams and leaders quickly assess workspace health and activity.
features: Overview of active vs. inactive workspaces
Trend analysis of workspace creation and member growth
Charts for usage of key features like pages and databases
Drill-down into specific workspace metrics for detailed insights

tool_suggestions.title: User Engagement Monitoring Tool
tool_suggestions.prompt: Build a tool to track user engagement levels and activity patterns within the platform, aiding in improving user retention strategies.
features: Visualize user active vs. inactive periods over time
Identify top users based on activity frequency and impact
Analyze trends in user sign-ups and participation
Alerts for sudden drops or spikes in user activity

tool_suggestions.title: Project Management Insights Tool
tool_suggestions.prompt: Develop a tool to provide insights into project progress and status, enabling teams to manage tasks and priorities efficiently.
features: Overview dashboard showing status of all projects
Filters to view tasks by priority and due date
Comparative analysis of project timelines and delays
Task assignment tracker to monitor workloads
